keywords.title: Niche keywords
keywords.description: Stores whose name, description, domain, product types or brands contain one of these, e.g. "tea", "pet supplies", "skincare". Short keywords (3 letters or fewer) match whole words only.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Leave out stores matching any of these.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Two-letter country codes of the business, e.g. "US", "GB", "AU".

locationKeywords.title: City or state
locationKeywords.description: City or state/province contains one of these, e.g. "Texas", "London".

shipsTo.title: Ships to
shipsTo.description: Stores that ship to at least one of these countries, e.g. "CA".

minProducts.title: Minimum products
minProducts.description: Only stores with at least this many published products.

maxProducts.title: Maximum products
maxProducts.description: Only stores with at most this many products, e.g. 200 for small shops.

minMedianPrice.title: Minimum typical price
minMedianPrice.description: Median product price at least this much, in the store's own currency.

maxMedianPrice.title: Maximum typical price
maxMedianPrice.description: Median product price at most this much, in the store's own currency.

activeWithinDays.title: Added a product within (days)
activeWithinDays.description: Only active stores: published a product in the last N days.

minProductsAddedLast30Days.title: Minimum products added (30 days)
minProductsAddedLast30Days.description: Stores growing their catalog: at least this many products published in the last 30 days.

requireEmail.title: Has an email
requireEmail.description: Only stores that publish an email address on their homepage or contact page.

requirePhone.title: Has a phone
requirePhone.description: Only stores that publish a phone number.

requireSocials.title: Has these social profiles
requireSocials.description: Only stores linking to a profile on each selected network.

apps.title: Uses any of these apps
apps.description: Detected from the scripts on the store's homepage.

themes.title: Theme
themes.description: Theme name contains one of these, e.g. "Dawn", "Impulse".

foundWithinDays.title: Found within (days)
foundWithinDays.description: Only stores our index found in the last N days.

onlyNewSinceLastRun.title: Only stores new since this search last ran
onlyNewSinceLastRun.description: For scheduled runs: return only stores the index found since this same search last ran. The Actor remembers each search in a key-value store named shopify-stores-monitor in your account; changing any filter starts a new history.

monitorName.title: Search name (optional)
monitorName.description: Only needed to keep two searches with identical filters separate, e.g. one per client.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Which stores come first. The maximum below keeps the top of this list.

maxResults.title: Maximum stores
maxResults.description: Hard cap on results, and your main cost control: you are charged per store returned.
